mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST < 500,000 units) indicates weak residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 500,000.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals an elevated inflation risk that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a sharp deterioration in labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (defined as negative GDP growth, GDPC1 quarterly growth < 0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion, over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth is negative.
